items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: they handed me a piece of music which was Schubert’s “Serenade,” which I’d played five years earlier.

ctx.x: Were you a member of the musician’s union at this time?

Yeah I joined when I was eighteen. And it was a joke almost. I got in there and they said — they handed me a piece of music which was Schubert’s “Serenade,” which I’d played five years earlier. I sat down and I went [scats]. That’s all right. Okay. That’s enough. So I could read whatever was put there. Kind of silly
